segments.name: U.S.
segments.description: Sells parts and assemblies manufactured through the marketplace, plus advertising and marketing services, to buyers in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company's U.S. revenues primarily result from the sales of parts and assemblies and the sale of advertising and marketing services.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Sells parts and assemblies manufactured through the marketplace to buyers outside the United States, mainly in Germany.
segments.evidence: Xometry is organized in two segments referred to as: (1) the U.S. and (2) International.
